subject.title: feat(memory): add multi-slot memory role architecture

question: Should OpenClaw adopt these five role-specific global and per-agent memory slots, including `memoryRole` as a permanent public plugin hook contract?
rationale: The patch establishes long-lived configuration, migration, and external plugin API semantics; mechanical correctness fixes cannot determine the permanent role set or whether lifecycle ownership belongs in this hook contract.

options.title: Adopt the full role contract
options.body: Approve all five slots and the hook API after the type, SDK artifact, upgrade, and exact-head proof blockers are resolved.

options.title: Land a narrower foundation
options.body: Approve only the roles with complete runtime invocation semantics and defer the remaining role keys and hooks.

options.title: Retain the single-slot model
options.body: Decline this public contract and pursue composition through a different generic plugin API or owner-specific integrations.

recommendation.title: Adopt the full role contract
recommendation.body: Approve all five slots and the hook API after the type, SDK artifact, upgrade, and exact-head proof blockers are resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the current central memory runtime/API surfaces and is the strongest history-backed owner for the product contract decision.
